你是执行者，这份文档是你唯一的任务来源；中途没人可问，拿不准写进 BLOCKED.md 跳过继续，最后随交付提交。
断了/新会话：先读 PROGRESS.md 接着做，别重做；每完成一项立刻更新。
这活为什么干：异常处置只有自由文本 note，经验不可复用；干完后运营打开任务能同时看到「历史统计」和「已发布剧本」，闭环时动作+效果可结构化沉淀。
让步顺序：结构化闭环正确 > 双轨效果可查询 > 三平台骨架可演示 > UI 好看。
死规矩=「只允许/不许」违反即失败；「建议」可换路并记 PROGRESS.md。

## 我替领导拍的板
1. 可指导=A+B（已确认）：任务详情同时返回历史Top统计 + 仅published剧本；无剧本时统计仍可用。
2. 效果=标签+指标双轨：resolve 必填 effect_code；metric_effect 可空，有 fact 时异步回填，无 fact 不失败。
3. 范围=三平台各1类：amazon/link_wow_units_drop、tiktok/low_roi、temu/listing_off。
4. 知识来源=预置码表+任务回写聚合；不做 LLM、不挖旧 free-text。
5. 可指导不含自动改价/预算（G3）；推荐只读+人选用。
6. 交付=一份垂直切片（API+迁移+最小Web+测试）。
7. pytest 若未装：允许在 backend 虚拟环境 pip install pytest pytest-asyncio httpx，记 PROGRESS；可往 requirements.txt 追加测试依赖一行。

## 界限
只允许改/新建：
- backend/migrations/004_ops_knowledge.sql（或下一可用序号）
- backend/app/domain/（task_engine 及相关新模块 kb_*.py）
- backend/app/api/（tasks.py 扩展 + 新 kb 路由并挂 main.py）
- backend/app/scripts/（种子扩展，可选）
- backend/tests/（新建测试）
- web/src/（App.vue / api.js 最小展示）
- docs/openapi-v1.yaml（与实现同步）
- 仓库根 PROGRESS.md、BLOCKED.md
- backend/requirements.txt 仅可追加 pytest/pytest-asyncio（若测需要）
其余路径只读。不许改 CI/密钥/docker 生产凭据/001–003 已落地 SQL 语义（可新 migration 扩展列）。
判卷：本任务书与测试文件可增不可删断言放宽。最诱人顺手活（飞书同步字段、环比跑批修复、导航大改）→ BLOCKED.md。

## 现状与任务0（2026-07-29 实测）
- task_progress 仅 note 自由文本；无 action_code/effect/知识表（001_init.sql）。
- AMZ 规则种子4条在 002；演示种子含三平台多类型（seed_demo_tasks.py）。
- backend/tests 目录空；默认 python 无 pytest/fastapi；存在 backend/.venv（True）。
- API：POST /api/v1/tasks/{id}/progress|resolve 仅 note（tasks.py）。
任务0：在 backend/.venv 跑 python -c "import fastapi; print(fastapi.__version__)"；失败则用该 venv pip 装 requirements 再核。写 PROGRESS 开工回执≤10行（目标/顺序/最大风险）再动工。对不上现状就停，证据置顶 BLOCKED.md。

## 任务1 数据模型
新增：ops_action_dict(code,name,platform可空,enabled)；ops_effect_dict(code,name,enabled)；task_progress 增 action_code/effect_code 可空+兼容旧 note；task 可冗余 last_action_code/last_effect_code；kb_playbook(id,platform,anomaly_type,title,body,action_codes[],status draft|published|rejected,evidence jsonb,created_at…)；可选 task_effect_metric(task_id, window_days, metric, before, after, delta_ratio, computed_at) 或 JSON 挂 task。
种子：≥3 action（每平台至少1）、≥4 effect（recovered/partial/no_effect/false_positive）、3 条骨架 anomaly 各 1 条 published 剧本（可短）。
验收：psql 或 SQLAlchemy 查表存在；三字典/剧本 count≥上述。

## 任务2 写路径
扩展 progress：可选 action_code+note；resolve：effect_code 对三骨架类型必填（其它类型可仅 note 兼容）；非法 code→400。
指标回填：提供函数/POST /api/v1/kb/metric-backfill 对 amazon+link_wow_units_drop 在 fact_amz_link_daily 有数据时写入 metric；无数据返回 skipped 不 500。
验收：venv 下 pytest -q 覆盖 合法闭环 / 缺 effect_code 400 / 未知 action 400；测试数≥4 且 skipped=0。

## 任务3 读路径 A+B
GET /api/v1/kb/guidance?platform=&anomaly_type= 返回：
- history: 按 action_code 聚合次数与 effect 分布（可空数组）
- playbooks: 仅 status=published
POST /api/v1/kb/playbooks/generate-draft 从 history 生成 draft（draft 不得出现在 guidance.playbooks）；POST .../publish 变 published。
验收：先 seed 结构化闭环≥2 → guidance.history 非空；draft 不出现在 guidance.playbooks；publish 后出现。反向：把 published 改 draft 后再 GET，playbooks 不得含该条（测后还原）。

## 任务4 最小 Web
任务抽屉/详情：调 guidance 展示两块标题「历史参考」「已发布剧本」；闭环表单可选 action + 必选 effect（骨架类型）。不求美观。
验收：手测或页面不报错即可；API 契约测试不过则本任务不算完成。

## 规矩
防作弊：禁止 pytest skip/xfail 滥用、放宽断言、mock 掉 DB 却声称集成通过、删测、|| true；测试只许≥开工基线（基线0，交付≥4）。
不新增鉴权体系；沿用 get_current_user。同一验收连败3次换项；比开工差则回滚报告。
进度：PROGRESS.md；卡死：BLOCKED.md。

## 完成条件
硬指标1：对三骨架类型各至少1次「resolve 带 action+effect」后，guidance 返回 history，且至少1条 published playbook 可被 GET 到。
硬指标2：白名单外 git diff 为空（或仅 PROGRESS/BLOCKED）；无自动执行平台操作代码。
每条验收在对话贴真实命令输出（含反向验证红→绿）。BLOCKED.md 必交（无则写「无」）。
止损：有效工时约1个工作日或同项失败3次→停，如实汇报。

    { key: 'in_progress', label: '进行中', count: items.filter((t) => t.status === 'in_progress').length, color: '#f59e0b' },

    { key: 'cancelled', label: '已取消', count: items.filter((t) => t.status === 'cancelled').length, color: '#9ca3af' },

  } catch {
    /* ignore */

}

function toggleDomain(id) {
  expandedDomains.value[id] = !expandedDomains.value[id]

}

function toggleSystem() {
  systemOpen.value = !systemOpen.value
  try {
    localStorage.setItem(SYSTEM_KEY, systemOpen.value ? '1' : '0')
  } catch {
    /* ignore */
  }
}

function statusLabel(s) {
  return (
    {
      open: '待处理',
      in_progress: '进行中',
      resolved: '已闭环',
      cancelled: '已取消',
    }[s] || s
  )
}

function fmtTime(v) {
  if (!v) return '—'
  try {
    return new Date(v).toLocaleString()
  } catch {
    return String(v)

}

function switchTab(id) {
  if (id === 'tk-tasks') {
    openGlobalTasks('tiktok')
    return
  }
  if (id === 'temu-tasks') {
    openGlobalTasks('temu')
    return
  }

  activeTab.value = id
  error.value = ''
  syncMsg.value = ''
  aiMsg.value = ''

  for (const d of DOMAIN_NAV) {
    if (d.children.some((c) => c.id === id)) {
      expandedDomains.value[d.id] = true
      persistExpand()
    }
  }
  if (SYSTEM_NAV.some((n) => n.id === id)) {
    systemOpen.value = true
    try {
      localStorage.setItem(SYSTEM_KEY, '1')
    } catch {
      /* ignore */
    }
  }

    filters.platform = 'amazon'
    filters.page = 1
  } else if (id === 'temu-health') {
    filters.platform = 'temu'
    filters.page = 1

    id === 'boss' ||
    id === 'dashboard' ||
    id.endsWith('-overview') ||
    id === 'plugins' ||
    id === 'tk-ads' ||
    id === 'tk-report' ||
    id.startsWith('purchase-') ||
    id.startsWith('design-') ||
    id === 'finance' ||
    id === 'amz-replenish'

    filters.platform = ''
    filters.page = 1
  }
}

  try {
    localStorage.setItem(SYSTEM_KEY, '1')
  } catch {

  loadTasks()
}

  filters.page = 1
  return loadTasks()

    if (activeTab.value === 'shops') await loadShops()
    else await Promise.all([loadTasks(), loadShops(), checkHealth()])
  } catch (e) {
    if (e.status === 401) logout()
    else error.value = e.message
  } finally {
    loading.value = false
  }
}

async function checkHealth() {
  try {

  } catch (e) {
    health.value = { status: 'down', detail: e.message }

}

async function doLogin() {

  loading.value = true

      auth: false,

    setToken(data.access_token)
    token.value = data.access_token
    activeTab.value = 'boss'
    await bootstrap()
  } catch (e) {
    error.value = e.message
  } finally {
    loading.value = false
  }
}

function logout() {
  setToken('')
  token.value = ''
  me.value = null
  tasks.value = []
  shops.value = []
  activeTab.value = 'boss'
}

async function bootstrap() {
  error.value = ''
  loading.value = true
  try {
    me.value = await api('/api/v1/auth/me')

  } catch (e) {

    error.value = e.message
  } finally {
    loading.value = false
  }
}

async function loadTasks() {
  const q = new URLSearchParams()
  if (filters.status) q.set('status', filters.status)
  if (filters.platform) q.set('platform', filters.platform)
  q.set('page', String(filters.page))
  q.set('page_size', String(filters.page_size))
  const data = await api(`/api/v1/tasks?${q.toString()}`)
  tasks.value = data.items || []
  total.value = data.total || 0
}

async function loadShops() {
  const data = await api('/api/v1/shops')
  shops.value = data.items || []
}

function openProgress(task) {
  drawer.open = true
  drawer.mode = 'progress'
  drawer.task = task
  drawer.note = ''
}

function openResolve(task) {

  drawer.mode = 'resolve'
  drawer.task = task
  drawer.note = '已处理完成'
}

function openCreate() {

  drawer.mode = 'create'

  drawer.note = ''

  createForm.title = ''
  createForm.progress_note = ''

  else if (filters.platform) createForm.platform = filters.platform
}

function closeDrawer() {
  drawer.open = false
}

async function submitDrawer() {
  error.value = ''
  loading.value = true
  try {
    if (drawer.mode === 'create') {
      if (!createForm.biz_id || !createForm.title) throw new Error('请填写业务ID与标题')
      await api('/api/v1/tasks', {
        method: 'POST',
        body: {
          platform: createForm.platform,
          anomaly_type: createForm.anomaly_type,
          biz_id: createForm.biz_id,
          title: createForm.title,
          progress_note: createForm.progress_note || undefined,
        },
      })
    } else if (drawer.mode === 'progress') {
      if (!drawer.note.trim()) throw new Error('请填写进度说明')
      await api(`/api/v1/tasks/${drawer.task.id}/progress`, {
        method: 'POST',
        body: { note: drawer.note, status: 'in_progress' },
      })
    } else if (drawer.mode === 'resolve') {
      await api(`/api/v1/tasks/${drawer.task.id}/resolve`, {
        method: 'POST',
        body: { note: drawer.note || undefined },
      })
    }
    closeDrawer()
    await loadTasks()
  } catch (e) {
    error.value = e.message
  } finally {
    loading.value = false
  }
}

async function triggerFeishu() {
  error.value = ''
  syncMsg.value = ''
  loading.value = true
  try {

    error.value = e.message

    loading.value = false

}

  error.value = ''

}

}

const showTaskActions = computed(

watch(activeTab, async (id) => {

      id === 'boss' ||
      id.startsWith('amz-') ||

      id === 'temu-shipping' ||
      id === 'amz-shipping'

    if (needShops) await loadShops()
  } catch (e) {
    if (e.status === 401) logout()
    else error.value = e.message
  }
})

onMounted(async () => {

  if (token.value) {

    }
  }
})

"""任务引擎：去重键 + 进行中唯一 + 闭环后重建。"""

from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone
from typing import Any
from uuid import uuid4

from sqlalchemy import text
from sqlalchemy.exc import IntegrityError
from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import AsyncSession

from app.config import get_settings


def build_dedupe_key(platform: str, biz_id: str, anomaly_type: str) -> str:
    return f"{platform}:{biz_id}:{anomaly_type}"


async def enqueue_feishu_sync(db: AsyncSession, task_id: str) -> None:
    await db.execute(
        text(
            """
            INSERT INTO outbox_event (id, event_type, aggregate_type, aggregate_id, payload)
            VALUES (:id, 'feishu.sync', 'task', :task_id, CAST(:payload AS jsonb))
            """
        ),
        {
            "id": str(uuid4()),
            "task_id": task_id,
            "payload": f'{{"table_key":"tasks","local_id":"{task_id}"}}',
        },
    )


async def upsert_task_from_anomaly(
    db: AsyncSession,
    *,
    platform: str,
    shop_id: str | None,
    anomaly_type: str,
    biz_id: str,
    title: str,
    detail: str | None = None,
    payload: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
    owner_user_id: str | None = None,
    severity: str = "warn",
    biz_id_type: str = "unknown",
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """存在未闭环同键任务则更新进度；否则新建。"""
    settings = get_settings()
    dedupe = build_dedupe_key(platform, biz_id, anomaly_type)
    now = datetime.now(timezone.utc)
    event_id = str(uuid4())

    await db.execute(
        text(
            """
            INSERT INTO anomaly_event (
                id, platform, shop_id, anomaly_type, biz_id, biz_id_type,
                dedupe_key, severity, title, detail, payload, detected_at
            ) VALUES (
                :id, :platform, :shop_id, :anomaly_type, :biz_id, :biz_id_type,
                :dedupe_key, :severity, :title, :detail, CAST(:payload AS jsonb), :detected_at
            )
            """
        ),
        {
            "id": event_id,
            "platform": platform,
            "shop_id": shop_id,
            "anomaly_type": anomaly_type,
            "biz_id": biz_id,
            "biz_id_type": biz_id_type,
            "dedupe_key": dedupe,
            "severity": severity,
            "title": title,
            "detail": detail,
            "payload": __import__("json").dumps(payload or {}, ensure_ascii=False),
            "detected_at": now,
        },
    )

    existing = (
        await db.execute(
            text(
                """
                SELECT id::text, status, progress_note
                FROM task
                WHERE dedupe_key = :dedupe AND status IN ('open', 'in_progress')
                LIMIT 1
                """
            ),
            {"dedupe": dedupe},
        )
    ).mappings().first()

    if existing:
        note = detail or title
        await db.execute(
            text(
                """
                UPDATE task
                SET progress_note = :note,
                    source_event_id = :event_id,
                    updated_at = :now,
                    status = CASE WHEN status = 'open' THEN 'in_progress' ELSE status END
                WHERE id = :id
                """
            ),
            {"note": note, "event_id": event_id, "now": now, "id": existing["id"]},
        )
        await db.execute(
            text(
                """

async def get_task(db: AsyncSession, task_id: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
    row = (
        await db.execute(
            text(
                """
                SELECT id::text, dedupe_key, status, platform, shop_id::text, anomaly_type,
                       biz_id, title, owner_user_id::text, due_at, progress_note,
                       created_at, updated_at, resolved_at
                FROM task WHERE id = :id
                """
            ),
            {"id": task_id},
        )
    ).mappings().first()
    if not row:
        raise ValueError("task not found")
    return dict(row)


async def update_progress(
    db: AsyncSession,
    task_id: str,
    note: str,
    status: str | None = None,
    operator_user_id: str | None = None,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    current = await get_task(db, task_id)
    if current["status"] in ("resolved", "cancelled"):
        raise ValueError("已闭环/取消的任务不能更新进度")
    new_status = status or "in_progress"
    if new_status not in ("open", "in_progress"):
        raise ValueError("进度接口仅允许 open/in_progress")
    now = datetime.now(timezone.utc)
    await db.execute(
        text(
            """
            UPDATE task SET progress_note = :note, status = :status, updated_at = :now
            WHERE id = :id
            """
        ),
        {"note": note, "status": new_status, "now": now, "id": task_id},
    )
    await db.execute(
        text(
            """
            INSERT INTO task_progress (id, task_id, note, from_status, to_status, operator_user_id)
            VALUES (:id, :task_id, :note, :from_status, :to_status, :operator)
            """
        ),
        {
            "id": str(uuid4()),
            "task_id": task_id,
            "note": note,
            "from_status": current["status"],
            "to_status": new_status,
            "operator": operator_user_id,
        },
    )
    await enqueue_feishu_sync(db, task_id)
    await db.commit()
    return await get_task(db, task_id)


async def resolve_task(
    db: AsyncSession,
    task_id: str,
    note: str | None = None,
    operator_user_id: str | None = None,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    current = await get_task(db, task_id)
    if current["status"] == "resolved":
        return current
    now = datetime.now(timezone.utc)
    final_note = note or current.get("progress_note") or "已闭环"
    await db.execute(
        text(
            """
            UPDATE task
            SET status = 'resolved', progress_note = :note,
                resolved_at = :now, updated_at = :now
            WHERE id = :id
            """
        ),
        {"note": final_note, "now": now, "id": task_id},
    )
    await db.execute(
        text(
            """
            INSERT INTO task_progress (id, task_id, note, from_status, to_status, operator_user_id)
            VALUES (:id, :task_id, :note, :from_status, 'resolved', :operator)
            """
        ),
        {
            "id": str(uuid4()),
            "task_id": task_id,
            "note": final_note,
            "from_status": current["status"],
            "operator": operator_user_id,
        },
    )
    await enqueue_feishu_sync(db, task_id)
    await db.commit()
    return await get_task(db, task_id)

      await api(`/api/v1/tasks/${drawer.task.id}/progress`, {
        method: 'POST',
        body: {
          note: drawer.note,
          status: 'in_progress',
          action_code: drawer.action_code || undefined,

      })

      if (isSkeletonTask(drawer.task) && !drawer.effect_code) {

          action_code: drawer.action_code || undefined,

        },

  } finally {

  }
}

"""运营知识库：动作/效果校验、历史聚合、剧本草稿/发布、指标回填。"""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
from datetime import date, datetime, timedelta, timezone
from typing import Any
from uuid import uuid4

from sqlalchemy import text
from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import AsyncSession

# 首期三平台骨架类型（resolve 必填 effect_code）
SKELETON_TYPES: frozenset[tuple[str, str]] = frozenset(
    {
        ("amazon", "link_wow_units_drop"),
        ("tiktok", "low_roi"),
        ("temu", "listing_off"),
    }
)


def is_skeleton_type(platform: str, anomaly_type: str) -> bool:
    return (platform, anomaly_type) in SKELETON_TYPES


async def action_exists(db: AsyncSession, code: str) -> bool:
    row = (
        await db.execute(
            text(
                """
                SELECT 1 FROM ops_action_dict
                WHERE code = :c AND enabled = TRUE
                LIMIT 1
                """
            ),
            {"c": code},
        )
    ).first()
    return row is not None


async def effect_exists(db: AsyncSession, code: str) -> bool:
    row = (
        await db.execute(
            text(
                """
                SELECT 1 FROM ops_effect_dict
                WHERE code = :c AND enabled = TRUE
                LIMIT 1
                """
            ),
            {"c": code},
        )
    ).first()
    return row is not None


async def validate_action_code(db: AsyncSession, action_code: str | None) -> None:
    if action_code is None or action_code == "":
        return
    if not await action_exists(db, action_code):
        raise ValueError(f"未知 action_code: {action_code}")


async def validate_effect_code(db: AsyncSession, effect_code: str | None) -> None:
    if effect_code is None or effect_code == "":
        return
    if not await effect_exists(db, effect_code):
        raise ValueError(f"未知 effect_code: {effect_code}")


async def get_guidance(
    db: AsyncSession, platform: str, anomaly_type: str
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """A 历史统计 + B 仅 published 剧本。"""
    rows = (
        await db.execute(
            text(
                """
                SELECT tp.action_code, tp.effect_code, COUNT(*)::int AS cnt
                FROM task_progress tp
                JOIN task t ON t.id = tp.task_id
                WHERE t.platform = :platform
                  AND t.anomaly_type = :anomaly_type
                  AND tp.action_code IS NOT NULL
                  AND tp.to_status = 'resolved'
                GROUP BY tp.action_code, tp.effect_code
                ORDER BY tp.action_code, cnt DESC
                """
            ),
            {"platform": platform, "anomaly_type": anomaly_type},
        )
    ).mappings().all()

    by_action: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {}
    for r in rows:
        ac = r["action_code"]
        bucket = by_action.setdefault(
            ac, {"action_code": ac, "count": 0, "effects": {}}
        )
        bucket["count"] += r["cnt"]
        ec = r["effect_code"] or "unknown"
        bucket["effects"][ec] = bucket["effects"].get(ec, 0) + r["cnt"]

    history = sorted(by_action.values(), key=lambda x: x["count"], reverse=True)

    playbooks = (
        await db.execute(
            text(
                """
                SELECT id::text, platform, anomaly_type, title, body,
                       action_codes, status, evidence, created_at, updated_at
                FROM kb_playbook
                WHERE platform = :platform
                  AND anomaly_type = :anomaly_type
                  AND status = 'published'
                ORDER BY updated_at DESC
                """
            ),
            {"platform": platform, "anomaly_type": anomaly_type},
        )
    ).mappings().all()

    return {
        "platform": platform,
        "anomaly_type": anomaly_type,
        "history": history,
        "playbooks": [dict(p) for p in playbooks],
    }


async def generate_draft_from_history(
    db: AsyncSession, platform: str, anomaly_type: str
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    guidance = await get_guidance(db, platform, anomaly_type)
    history = guidance["history"]
    top_actions = [h["action_code"] for h in history[:5]]
    if not top_actions:
        body = "暂无结构化历史；请人工补充处置步骤后发布。"
        title = f"{platform}/{anomaly_type} 草稿剧本（空历史）"
    else:
        lines = []
        for h in history[:5]:
            eff = ", ".join(f"{k}:{v}" for k, v in h["effects"].items())
            lines.append(f"- {h['action_code']} ×{h['count']}（{eff}）")
        body = "根据历史结构化闭环自动生成：\n" + "\n".join(lines)
        title = f"{platform}/{anomaly_type} 历史聚合草稿"

    now = datetime.now(timezone.utc)
    pid = str(uuid4())
    evidence = {
        "source": "generate-draft",
        "history_snapshot": history[:10],
        "generated_at": now.isoformat(),
    }
    await db.execute(
        text(
            """
            INSERT INTO kb_playbook (
                id, platform, anomaly_type, title, body, action_codes,
                status, evidence, created_at, updated_at
            ) VALUES (
                :id, :platform, :anomaly_type, :title, :body, :action_codes,
                'draft', CAST(:evidence AS jsonb), :now, :now
            )
            """
        ),
        {
            "id": pid,
            "platform": platform,
            "anomaly_type": anomaly_type,
            "title": title,
            "body": body,
            "action_codes": top_actions,
            "evidence": json.dumps(evidence, ensure_ascii=False),
            "now": now,
        },
    )
    await db.commit()
    return await get_playbook(db, pid)


async def get_playbook(db: AsyncSession, playbook_id: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
    row = (
        await db.execute(
            text(
                """
                SELECT id::text, platform, anomaly_type, title, body,
                       action_codes, status, evidence, created_at, updated_at
                FROM kb_playbook WHERE id = :id
                """
            ),
            {"id": playbook_id},
        )
    ).mappings().first()
    if not row:
        raise ValueError("playbook not found")
    return dict(row)


async def set_playbook_status(
    db: AsyncSession, playbook_id: str, status: str
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    if status not in ("draft", "published", "rejected"):
        raise ValueError("非法 status")
    now = datetime.now(timezone.utc)
    result = await db.execute(
        text(
            """
            UPDATE kb_playbook
            SET status = :status, updated_at = :now
            WHERE id = :id
            RETURNING id::text
            """
        ),
        {"status": status, "now": now, "id": playbook_id},
    )
    if not result.first():
        raise ValueError("playbook not found")
    await db.commit()
    return await get_playbook(db, playbook_id)


async def publish_playbook(db: AsyncSession, playbook_id: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
    return await set_playbook_status(db, playbook_id, "published")


async def metric_backfill_for_task(
    db: AsyncSession,
    task_id: str,
    *,
    window_days: int = 7,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """
    对 amazon/link_wow_units_drop：有 fact_amz_link_daily 则写 metric_effect；
    无数据返回 skipped，不抛错。
    """
    task = (
        await db.execute(
            text(
                """
                SELECT id::text, platform, anomaly_type, biz_id, resolved_at, status
                FROM task WHERE id = :id
                """
            ),
            {"id": task_id},
        )
    ).mappings().first()
    if not task:
        raise ValueError("task not found")

    if task["platform"] != "amazon" or task["anomaly_type"] != "link_wow_units_drop":
        return {
            "status": "skipped",
            "reason": "only amazon/link_wow_units_drop supported",
            "task_id": task_id,
        }

    anchor: date
    if task["resolved_at"]:
        ra = task["resolved_at"]
        if isinstance(ra, datetime):
            anchor = ra.date()
        else:
            anchor = date.today()
    else:
        anchor = date.today()

    before_start = anchor - timedelta(days=window_days * 2)
    before_end = anchor - timedelta(days=window_days)
    after_start = anchor
    after_end = anchor + timedelta(days=window_days)

    async def _avg_units(start: date, end: date) -> float | None:
        row = (
            await db.execute(
                text(
                    """
                    SELECT AVG(units)::float AS avg_units, COUNT(*)::int AS n
                    FROM fact_amz_link_daily
                    WHERE asin = :asin
                      AND biz_date >= :start
                      AND biz_date < :end
                    """
                ),
                {"asin": task["biz_id"], "start": start, "end": end},
            )
        ).mappings().first()
        if not row or not row["n"]:
            return None
        return float(row["avg_units"] or 0)

    before = await _avg_units(before_start, before_end)
    after = await _avg_units(after_start, after_end + timedelta(days=1))

    if before is None and after is None:
        return {
            "status": "skipped",
            "reason": "no fact_amz_link_daily rows for asin window",
            "task_id": task_id,
            "biz_id": task["biz_id"],
        }

    before_v = before if before is not None else 0.0
    after_v = after if after is not None else 0.0
    delta_ratio = None
    if before_v > 0:
        delta_ratio = (after_v - before_v) / before_v

    payload = {
        "window_days": window_days,
        "metric": "units",
        "before": before_v,
        "after": after_v,
        "delta_ratio": delta_ratio,
        "computed_at": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
        "anchor_date": anchor.isoformat(),
    }
    await db.execute(
        text(
            """
            UPDATE task
            SET metric_effect = CAST(:payload AS jsonb), updated_at = :now
            WHERE id = :id
            """
        ),
        {
            "payload": json.dumps(payload, ensure_ascii=False),
            "now": datetime.now(timezone.utc),
            "id": task_id,
        },
    )
    await db.commit()
    return {"status": "ok", "task_id": task_id, "metric_effect": payload}

from typing import Any
from uuid import uuid4

from sqlalchemy import text
from sqlalchemy.exc import IntegrityError
from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import AsyncSession

from app.config import get_settings
from app.domain import kb as kb_mod


def build_dedupe_key(platform: str, biz_id: str, anomaly_type: str) -> str:
    return f"{platform}:{biz_id}:{anomaly_type}"


async def enqueue_feishu_sync(db: AsyncSession, task_id: str) -> None:
    await db.execute(
        text(
            """
            INSERT INTO outbox_event (id, event_type, aggregate_type, aggregate_id, payload)
            VALUES (:id, 'feishu.sync', 'task', :task_id, CAST(:payload AS jsonb))
            """
        ),
        {
            "id": str(uuid4()),
            "task_id": task_id,
            "payload": f'{{"table_key":"tasks","local_id":"{task_id}"}}',
        },
    )


async def upsert_task_from_anomaly(
    db: AsyncSession,
    *,
    platform: str,
    shop_id: str | None,
    anomaly_type: str,
    biz_id: str,
    title: str,
    detail: str | None = None,
    payload: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
    owner_user_id: str | None = None,
    severity: str = "warn",
    biz_id_type: str = "unknown",
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """存在未闭环同键任务则更新进度；否则新建。"""
    settings = get_settings()
    dedupe = build_dedupe_key(platform, biz_id, anomaly_type)
    now = datetime.now(timezone.utc)
    event_id = str(uuid4())

    await db.execute(
        text(
            """
            INSERT INTO anomaly_event (
                id, platform, shop_id, anomaly_type, biz_id, biz_id_type,
                dedupe_key, severity, title, detail, payload, detected_at
            ) VALUES (
                :id, :platform, :shop_id, :anomaly_type, :biz_id, :biz_id_type,
                :dedupe_key, :severity, :title, :detail, CAST(:payload AS jsonb), :detected_at
            )
            """
        ),
        {
            "id": event_id,
            "platform": platform,
            "shop_id": shop_id,
            "anomaly_type": anomaly_type,
            "biz_id": biz_id,
            "biz_id_type": biz_id_type,
            "dedupe_key": dedupe,
            "severity": severity,
            "title": title,
            "detail": detail,
            "payload": __import__("json").dumps(payload or {}, ensure_ascii=False),
            "detected_at": now,
        },
    )

    existing = (
        await db.execute(
            text(
                """
                SELECT id::text, status, progress_note
                FROM task
                WHERE dedupe_key = :dedupe AND status IN ('open', 'in_progress')
                LIMIT 1
                """
            ),
            {"dedupe": dedupe},
        )
    ).mappings().first()

    if existing:
        note = detail or title
        await db.execute(
            text(
                """
                UPDATE task
                SET progress_note = :note,
                    source_event_id = :event_id,
                    updated_at = :now,
                    status = CASE WHEN status = 'open' THEN 'in_progress' ELSE status END
                WHERE id = :id
                """
            ),
            {"note": note, "event_id": event_id, "now": now, "id": existing["id"]},
        )
        await db.execute(
            text(
                """
                INSERT INTO task_progress (id, task_id, note, from_status, to_status)
                VALUES (:id, :task_id, :note, :from_status, 'in_progress')
                """
            ),
            {
                "id": str(uuid4()),
                "task_id": existing["id"],
                "note": note,
                "from_status": existing["status"],
            },
        )
        await db.execute(
            text("UPDATE anomaly_event SET task_id = :task_id WHERE id = :id"),
            {"task_id": existing["id"], "id": event_id},
        )
        await enqueue_feishu_sync(db, existing["id"])
        await db.commit()
        return await get_task(db, existing["id"])

    task_id = str(uuid4())
    due_at = now + timedelta(days=settings.default_task_due_days)
    try:
        await db.execute(
            text(
                """
                INSERT INTO task (
                    id, dedupe_key, status, platform, shop_id, anomaly_type, biz_id,
                    title, owner_user_id, due_at, progress_note, source_event_id,
                    created_at, updated_at
                ) VALUES (
                    :id, :dedupe_key, 'open', :platform, :shop_id, :anomaly_type, :biz_id,
                    :title, :owner_user_id, :due_at, :progress_note, :source_event_id,
                    :now, :now
                )
                """
            ),
            {
                "id": task_id,
                "dedupe_key": dedupe,
                "platform": platform,
                "shop_id": shop_id,
                "anomaly_type": anomaly_type,
                "biz_id": biz_id,
                "title": title,
                "owner_user_id": owner_user_id,
                "due_at": due_at,
                "progress_note": detail,
                "source_event_id": event_id,
                "now": now,
            },
        )
    except IntegrityError:
        await db.rollback()
        # 并发下已有 open 任务，转更新
        return await upsert_task_from_anomaly(
            db,
            platform=platform,
            shop_id=shop_id,
            anomaly_type=anomaly_type,
            biz_id=biz_id,
            title=title,
            detail=detail,
            payload=payload,
            owner_user_id=owner_user_id,
            severity=severity,
            biz_id_type=biz_id_type,
        )

    await db.execute(
        text("UPDATE anomaly_event SET task_id = :task_id WHERE id = :id"),
        {"task_id": task_id, "id": event_id},
    )
    await db.execute(
        text(
            """
            INSERT INTO task_progress (id, task_id, note, from_status, to_status)
            VALUES (:id, :task_id, :note, NULL, 'open')
            """
        ),
        {"id": str(uuid4()), "task_id": task_id, "note": detail or "创建任务"},
    )
    await enqueue_feishu_sync(db, task_id)
    await db.commit()
    return await get_task(db, task_id)


async def get_task(db: AsyncSession, task_id: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
    row = (
        await db.execute(
            text(
                """
                SELECT id::text, dedupe_key, status, platform, shop_id::text, anomaly_type,
                       biz_id, title, owner_user_id::text, due_at, progress_note,
                       last_action_code, last_effect_code, metric_effect,
                       created_at, updated_at, resolved_at
                FROM task WHERE id = :id
                """
            ),
            {"id": task_id},
        )
    ).mappings().first()
    if not row:
        raise ValueError("task not found")
    return dict(row)


async def update_progress(
    db: AsyncSession,
    task_id: str,
    note: str,
    status: str | None = None,
    operator_user_id: str | None = None,
    action_code: str | None = None,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    current = await get_task(db, task_id)
    if current["status"] in ("resolved", "cancelled"):
        raise ValueError("已闭环/取消的任务不能更新进度")
    new_status = status or "in_progress"
    if new_status not in ("open", "in_progress"):
        raise ValueError("进度接口仅允许 open/in_progress")
    await kb_mod.validate_action_code(db, action_code)
    now = datetime.now(timezone.utc)
    await db.execute(
        text(
            """
            UPDATE task
            SET progress_note = :note,
                status = :status,
                updated_at = :now,
                last_action_code = COALESCE(:action_code, last_action_code)
            WHERE id = :id
            """
        ),
        {
            "note": note,
            "status": new_status,
            "now": now,
            "id": task_id,
            "action_code": action_code,
        },
    )
    await db.execute(
        text(
            """
            INSERT INTO task_progress (
                id, task_id, note, from_status, to_status, operator_user_id, action_code
            )
            VALUES (
                :id, :task_id, :note, :from_status, :to_status, :operator, :action_code
            )
            """
        ),
        {
            "id": str(uuid4()),
            "task_id": task_id,
            "note": note,
            "from_status": current["status"],
            "to_status": new_status,
            "operator": operator_user_id,
            "action_code": action_code,
        },
    )
    await enqueue_feishu_sync(db, task_id)
    await db.commit()
    return await get_task(db, task_id)


async def resolve_task(
    db: AsyncSession,
    task_id: str,
    note: str | None = None,
    operator_user_id: str | None = None,
    action_code: str | None = None,
    effect_code: str | None = None,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    current = await get_task(db, task_id)
    if current["status"] == "resolved":
        return current

    platform = current["platform"]
    anomaly_type = current["anomaly_type"]
    skeleton = kb_mod.is_skeleton_type(platform, anomaly_type)

    await kb_mod.validate_action_code(db, action_code)
    await kb_mod.validate_effect_code(db, effect_code)

    if skeleton and not effect_code:
        raise ValueError("骨架异常类型闭环必须填写 effect_code")

    now = datetime.now(timezone.utc)
    final_note = note or current.get("progress_note") or "已闭环"
    final_action = action_code or current.get("last_action_code")

    await db.execute(
        text(
            """
            UPDATE task
            SET status = 'resolved',
                progress_note = :note,
                resolved_at = :now,
                updated_at = :now,
                last_action_code = COALESCE(:action_code, last_action_code),
                last_effect_code = COALESCE(:effect_code, last_effect_code)
            WHERE id = :id
            """
        ),
        {
            "note": final_note,
            "now": now,
            "id": task_id,
            "action_code": action_code,
            "effect_code": effect_code,
        },
    )
    await db.execute(
        text(
            """
            INSERT INTO task_progress (
                id, task_id, note, from_status, to_status, operator_user_id,
                action_code, effect_code
            )
            VALUES (
                :id, :task_id, :note, :from_status, 'resolved', :operator,
                :action_code, :effect_code
            )
            """
        ),
        {
            "id": str(uuid4()),
            "task_id": task_id,
            "note": final_note,
            "from_status": current["status"],
            "operator": operator_user_id,
            "action_code": final_action,
            "effect_code": effect_code,
        },
    )
    await enqueue_feishu_sync(db, task_id)
    await db.commit()
    return await get_task(db, task_id)

openapi: 3.0.3
info:
  title: 清泉跨境系统 API
  version: 0.1.0
  description: |
    Phase 0 接口草案。鉴权：用户 JWT（Bearer）或采集 API Key（X-Api-Key）。
servers:
  - url: http://localhost:8000
    description: local
tags:
  - name: health
  - name: auth
  - name: shops
  - name: ingest
  - name: tasks
  - name: export
  - name: collectors

paths:
  /health:
    get:
      tags: [health]
      summary: 健康检查
      responses:
        "200":
          description: OK
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                properties:
                  status: { type: string, example: ok }
                  time: { type: string, format: date-time }

  /api/v1/auth/login:
    post:
      tags: [auth]
      summary: 登录
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              type: object
              required: [username, password]
              properties:
                username: { type: string }
                password: { type: string, format: password }
      responses:
        "200":
          description: JWT
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                properties:
                  access_token: { type: string }
                  token_type: { type: string, example: bearer }
                  expires_in: { type: integer }
        "401":
          description: 用户名或密码错误

  /api/v1/auth/me:
    get:
      tags: [auth]
      summary: 当前用户
      security: [{ bearerAuth: [] }]
      responses:
        "200":
          description: 用户资料
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/User"

  /api/v1/shops:
    get:
      tags: [shops]
      summary: 店铺列表
      security: [{ bearerAuth: [] }]
      parameters:
        - in: query
          name: platform
          schema: { type: string, enum: [amazon, tiktok, temu, other] }
        - in: query
          name: status
          schema: { type: string, enum: [active, disabled] }
      responses:
        "200":
          description: OK
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                properties:
                  items:
                    type: array
                    items: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/Shop" }
    post:
      tags: [shops]
      summary: 创建店铺
      security: [{ bearerAuth: [] }]
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/ShopCreate" }
      responses:
        "201":
          description: Created
          content:
            application/json:
              schema: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/Shop" }

  /api/v1/shops/{shopId}:
    patch:
      tags: [shops]
      summary: 更新店铺
      security: [{ bearerAuth: [] }]
      parameters:
        - $ref: "#/components/parameters/shopId"
      requestBody:
        content:
          application/json:
            schema: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/ShopUpdate" }
      responses:
        "200":
          description: OK
          content:
            application/json:
              schema: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/Shop" }

  /api/v1/ingest/{source}:
    post:
      tags: [ingest]
      summary: 采集上报（单条或批量）
      security: [{ apiKeyAuth: [] }]
      parameters:
        - in: path
          name: source
          required: true
          schema:
            type: string
            enum:
              - tiktok_ads
              - temu_browser
              - temu_openapi
              - sellfox_sales
              - sellfox_performance
              - sellfox_product_temu
              - sellfox_sales_days
              - amazon_front
              - wms_inventory
              - hwc_bridge_event
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              oneOf:
                - $ref: "#/components/schemas/IngestEnvelope"
                - $ref: "#/components/schemas/IngestBatch"
            examples:
              single:
                summary: 单条 TK 广告
                value:
                  platform: tiktok
                  shop_id: "27501502216807"
                  shop_name: Deal to deal
                  biz_date: "2026-07-26"
                  collected_at: "2026-07-27T17:25:01+08:00"
                  idempotency_key: "tiktok_ads:27501502216807:拖把7/13:2026-07-26"
                  payload:
                    campaign_name: "拖把7/13"
                    spend: 187.79
                    orders: 121
                    roi: 9.9
                    revenue: 1872.64
                    row_status: success
              batch:
                summary: 批量
                value:
                  items:
                    - platform: tiktok
                      shop_id: "27501502216807"
                      shop_name: Deal to deal
                      biz_date: "2026-07-26"
                      collected_at: "2026-07-27T17:25:01+08:00"
                      idempotency_key: "tiktok_ads:27501502216807:拖把7/13:2026-07-26"
                      payload:
                        campaign_name: "拖把7/13"
                        spend: 187.79
                        orders: 121
                        roi: 9.9
                        revenue: 1872.64
      responses:
        "200":
          description: 接受（含幂等命中）
          content:
            application/json:
              schema: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/IngestResult" }
        "401":
          description: API Key 无效
        "422":
          description: 校验失败

  /api/v1/tasks:
    get:
      tags: [tasks]
      summary: 任务列表
      security: [{ bearerAuth: [] }]
      parameters:
        - in: query
          name: status
          schema: { type: string, enum: [open, in_progress, resolved, cancelled] }
        - in: query
          name: platform
          schema: { type: string }
        - in: query
          name: shop_id
          schema: { type: string, format: uuid }
        - in: query
          name: owner_user_id
          schema: { type: string, format: uuid }
        - in: query
          name: page
          schema: { type: integer, default: 1 }
        - in: query
          name: page_size
          schema: { type: integer, default: 20 }
      responses:
        "200":
          description: OK
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                properties:
                  total: { type: integer }
                  items:
                    type: array
                    items: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/Task" }
    post:
      tags: [tasks]
      summary: 手动创建任务
      security: [{ bearerAuth: [] }]
      requestBody:
        content:
          application/json:
            schema: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/TaskCreate" }
      responses:
        "201":
          description: Created
          content:
            application/json:
              schema: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/Task" }

  /api/v1/tasks/{taskId}/progress:
    post:
      tags: [tasks]
      summary: 更新进度（进行中任务）
      security: [{ bearerAuth: [] }]
      parameters:
        - $ref: "#/components/parameters/taskId"
      requestBody:
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              type: object
              required: [note]
              properties:
                note: { type: string }
                status:
                  type: string
                  enum: [open, in_progress]
                action_code:
                  type: string
                  description: 可选运营动作码（须存在于 ops_action_dict）
      responses:
        "200":
          description: OK
          content:
            application/json:
              schema: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/Task" }

  /api/v1/tasks/{taskId}/resolve:
    post:
      tags: [tasks]
      summary: 闭环任务
      security: [{ bearerAuth: [] }]
      parameters:
        - $ref: "#/components/parameters/taskId"
      requestBody:
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              type: object
              properties:
                note: { type: string }
                action_code: { type: string }
                effect_code:
                  type: string
                  description: 骨架类型（amazon/link_wow_units_drop、tiktok/low_roi、temu/listing_off）必填
      responses:
        "200":
          description: OK
          content:
            application/json:
              schema: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/Task" }

  /api/v1/kb/guidance:
    get:
      tags: [kb]
      summary: A+B 指导（历史统计 + 已发布剧本）
      security: [{ bearerAuth: [] }]
      parameters:
        - name: platform
          in: query
          required: true
          schema: { type: string }
        - name: anomaly_type
          in: query
          required: true
          schema: { type: string }
      responses:
        "200":
          description: history + published playbooks only
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                properties:
                  platform: { type: string }
                  anomaly_type: { type: string }
                  history:
                    type: array
                    items:
                      type: object
                      properties:
                        action_code: { type: string }
                        count: { type: integer }
                        effects: { type: object }
                  playbooks:
                    type: array
                    items: { type: object }

  /api/v1/kb/playbooks/generate-draft:
    post:
      tags: [kb]
      summary: 从历史聚合生成剧本草稿（draft，不进入 guidance.playbooks）
      security: [{ bearerAuth: [] }]
      requestBody:
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              type: object
              required: [platform, anomaly_type]
              properties:
                platform: { type: string }
                anomaly_type: { type: string }
      responses:
        "201":
          description: Draft playbook

  /api/v1/kb/playbooks/{playbookId}/publish:
    post:
      tags: [kb]
      summary: 发布剧本 draft→published
      security: [{ bearerAuth: [] }]
      parameters:
        - name: playbookId
          in: path
          required: true
          schema: { type: string, format: uuid }
      responses:
        "200":
          description: Published playbook

  /api/v1/kb/playbooks/{playbookId}/demote:
    post:
      tags: [kb]
      summary: 降级剧本 published→draft
      security: [{ bearerAuth: [] }]
      parameters:
        - name: playbookId
          in: path
          required: true
          schema: { type: string, format: uuid }
      responses:
        "200":
          description: Draft playbook

  /api/v1/kb/metric-backfill:
    post:
      tags: [kb]
      summary: 指标效果回填（amazon/link_wow_units_drop；无 fact 时 skipped）
      security: [{ bearerAuth: [] }]
      requestBody:
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              type: object
              required: [task_id]
              properties:
                task_id: { type: string, format: uuid }
                window_days: { type: integer, default: 7 }
      responses:
        "200":
          description: ok 或 skipped

  /api/v1/export/feishu:
    post:
      tags: [export]
      summary: 触发飞书同步
      security: [{ bearerAuth: [] }]
      requestBody:
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              type: object
              properties:
                table_key:
                  type: string
                  description: 逻辑表，如 tasks / tk_ads_daily
                  example: tasks
                mode:
                  type: string
                  enum: [incremental, rebuild]
                  default: incremental
                biz_date:
                  type: string
                  format: date
      responses:
        "202":
          description: 已入队
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                properties:
                  job_id: { type: string, format: uuid }

  /api/v1/collectors/heartbeat:
    post:
      tags: [collectors]
      summary: 边缘节点心跳
      security: [{ apiKeyAuth: [] }]
      requestBody:
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              type: object
              required: [node_id]
              properties:
                node_id: { type: string }
                version: { type: string }
                meta: { type: object, additionalProperties: true }
      responses:
        "200":
          description: OK
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                properties:
                  server_time: { type: string, format: date-time }
                  config_version: { type: string }

    bearerAuth:
      type: http
      scheme: bearer
      bearerFormat: JWT
    apiKeyAuth:
      type: apiKey
      in: header
      name: X-Api-Key

  parameters:
    shopId:
      in: path
      name: shopId
      required: true
      schema: { type: string, format: uuid }
    taskId:
      in: path
      name: taskId
      required: true
      schema: { type: string, format: uuid }

  schemas:
    User:
      type: object
      properties:
        id: { type: string, format: uuid }
        username: { type: string }
        display_name: { type: string }
        is_admin: { type: boolean }

    Shop:
      type: object
      properties:
        id: { type: string, format: uuid }
        platform: { type: string }
        external_shop_id: { type: string }
        name: { type: string }
        primary_owner_user_id: { type: string, format: uuid, nullable: true }
        timezone: { type: string }

        meta: { type: object, additionalProperties: true }

      type: object

from fastapi import FastAPI
from fastapi.middleware.cors import CORSMiddleware

from app.api import auth, export_feishu, health, ingest, kb, shops, tasks
from app.config import get_settings


def create_app() -> FastAPI:
    settings = get_settings()
    app = FastAPI(title=settings.app_name, version="0.1.0")
    app.add_middleware(
        CORSMiddleware,
        allow_origins=["*"],
        allow_credentials=True,
        allow_methods=["*"],
        allow_headers=["*"],
    )
    app.include_router(health.router)
    app.include_router(auth.router)
    app.include_router(shops.router)
    app.include_router(ingest.router)
    app.include_router(tasks.router)
    app.include_router(kb.router)

    app.include_router(export_feishu.router_collectors)
    return app
